 ((k.descFactorial 4:ℤ)+(l.descFactorial 4:ℤ)+
 (2*H+6)*((k.descFactorial 3:ℤ)+(l.descFactorial 3:ℤ))+
 (H+2)*(H+3)*((k.descFactorial 2:ℤ)+(l.descFactorial 2:ℤ)))
